rubric_addition_exact_verbatim.schema_line: "support": [{"quote": "verbatim text copied from the supplied review input"}],
rubric_addition_exact_verbatim.citation_rule:
- Every blocking finding must include `support`: at least one verbatim
  quote copied from the supplied review input (diff, description, or
  provided context) that the finding rests on. If you cannot quote the
  input, the finding is advisory.

deterministic_implementation.pinned_by: tests/test_support_contract.py at the subject SHA (187 tests green on this branch)
deterministic_implementation.support_corpus: effective_review_input(): the exact model-visible/budgeted input — title, body[:2000], changed-file list, per-file VISIBLE PATCH BYTES (file cap + legacy diff truncation, cuts can land in joiner or generated header); generated headers, policy text, engine notes and prompt framing are never matchable; matching is segment-local
deterministic_implementation.anti_vacuity_floor: normalized (casefold + whitespace-collapse) length >= 16 characters AND >= 3 lexical tokens — a quote shorter or lexically thinner cannot certify a blocker
deterministic_implementation.matching: casefold + whitespace-collapse substring within a single segment; deterministic first-match order (title, body, changed_files, then files)
deterministic_implementation.demotion: unsupported blocker -> canonical non-blocking severity + machine reason appended: [downgraded by support validation: support_missing | support_vacuous | support_not_found]; never dropped; >= 1 surviving blocker -> ISSUES_FOUND; all blockers demoted -> CLEAR (intentional demotion is not malformed evidence); C7-style label mismatch with no demotion stays INCONCLUSIVE (fail-closed path untouched)
deterministic_implementation.provenance: the engine annotates the first matching support item with engine_match {kind, id} (title/body/changed_files/diff + path); unmatched and vacuous items get no fabricated provenance; the model supplies only the quote

target_families.speculative-consequence: dominant false-blocker family — its blockers' premises typically depend on facts absent from the model-visible input and therefore cannot be quoted; citation presence does NOT establish relevance or entailment: a speculative finding may still find a matching quote while making an unsupported semantic leap — 20d determines whether citation presence actually separates the family (design §2.7/§3; no narrative vocabulary chase either way)
target_families.protected: M17 same-input contradiction (cache-wide absolute vs /health,/metrics origin bypass) — sensitivity is EMPIRICALLY protected by the frozen sonnet 5/5 floor, not mechanically guaranteed by the validator; the validator can only demote claims whose quotes fail presence/vacuity/matching, and a genuine finding can be lost if the model paraphrases instead of quoting (design §3)

mechanism_definition.hypothesis_falsifiable: layer (b) mechanically enforces citation PRESENCE, not entailment — this run measures whether forcing and validating a non-trivial evidence pointer materially improves discrimination without violating the floors

protocol.unexpected_blocking: fails that fixture's policy evaluation (mechanical, existing harness)
protocol.pair_integrity: computed under the existing harness; a positive's own pass is promotion-eligible only if its paired control also passes
protocol.keep_vs_binding: 20d KEEP criteria do not by themselves declare the binding T1.2 reference; binding-reference eligibility additionally requires the applicable full T1.2 gate — C7 clean on both profiles, zero GATING violations, and in-scope pair integrity

run_policy: exactly once; no reruns of failures/parser failures/ugly outputs; everything preserved as emitted; stop if projected cost would exceed the cap; authorized only by explicit human spend authorization after this freeze is reviewed
governed_calls_note: counts ONLY governed 20d corpus calls; ordinary per-PR dogfood AI reviews (e.g. the haiku run on this branch's exact head) are excluded from this count and do not contaminate the governed measurement
interpretation_on_pass: TWO separate predicates. 20d KEEP = the five frozen success criteria — a passing run keeps the layer (b) support contract. Binding-reference eligibility = KEEP PLUS the applicable full T1.2 gate (C7 clean both profiles, zero GATING violations, in-scope pair integrity per the protocol block) — only that combined result may be recorded as earning the binding T1.2 gating/discrimination reference. Neither predicate is T1.3 stage exit: the remaining families (hallucinated-fact, risk-boilerplate, severity-inflation, absolute-consistency) continue; no automatic entry into T1.4; a hard-invariant failure reverts the mechanism (rubric.md + engine policy via reviewer-side revert PRs) and records layer (b) measured insufficient — evidence that earns consideration of the next mechanism, which is not preemptively built
